rv.q: 44: The Musical's satirical take on former President Barack Obama falters with repetitive music, scattershot humor, and a thin point of view.
He sidles up to the Obama marriage, suggesting Michelle's FLOTUS resistance, which is fair enough. But where are the trenchant digs at all aspects of the Obama pros and cons personnel?
Those who like sophisticated entertainments are better off staying away.

cn.t: This Obama-era political satire relies heavily on vulgarity over substance, with critics finding the revue-style musical more crude than clever despite a hard-working cast's efforts.

vr.q: If all of this sounds like really ridiculously fun to you, then this is the show for you.
